fields.text: Bloom of the Heavens

I came to Menethil Harbor from Auberdine, from the great tree Teldrassil, to recover a bloom of great import to my people.

My people's ship the Flying Osprey crashed here many moons ago, joined with the Kul Tiran Third Fleet. Among its cargo was the flower known as Nord'el--Bloom of the Heavens in your tongue--bloomed under a full moon at the peak of Mount Hyjal, our former home.

Please help me retrieve it! The wreckage is just south of the city, but it is inhabited by fierce murloc raiders!
Recover Nord'el for Sylessa Duskwhisper in Menethil Harbor.
Have you been to the wreckage? It is a most somber sight.

It has survived! Oh, Elune be praised!

A thousand thanks, <name>. If you are willing, I do have one more favor to ask of you...
Ingredients for the Forge

Thelsamar's a great place to live, but we don't have all of the amenities of Ironforge. I'm always running out of bronze! I need more bronze if I'm going to keep making tools and kettles and pots!

I can tell you have a little experience at the forge. Think you could smelt me some bronze bars? I can pay you well for it!
Bring 10 Bronze Bars to Morhan Coppertongue.
Gotta keep the forges going!
Ah, this is a relief! I should be able to keep the forge going now. Hopefully one of these days we'll get a trader bringing coal into town regularly!
Spark of Freedom

Sss! The foul Dark Irons have summoned me and kept me caged next to their petty fire pit!

Fire must run wild, run free! Release me! Must escape! Must BURN!

No Dark Iron is safe! Burn them to the ground! Burn their black powder! Burn their fortress, their fuses, their folly!

Let me out and I will BURN THEM ALL!
Escort the captive fire elemental out of Dun Modr and to its freedom.

That was quite a pyrotechnic display! I don't think I've seen anything quite like it!

Glad the fire elemental, uh, ran outta steam, as it were. Coulda been bad if it had decided to go after the rest of us instead of those Dark Irons!
The Missing Diplomat

Excuse me, <sir/madam>. Bishop DeLavey asked me to approach adventurers that might be able to help him with a delicate matter.

If you could quietly head to Stormwind Keep and speak to him at your earliest convenience, I'm sure he would appreciate your help. Again, please be discreet. It is a matter of some importance.
Find Bishop DeLavey in Stormwind Keep.

Hello, <name>. I am Bishop DeLavey.

No doubt if you're asking me about my business here in the keep then young Thomas has succeeded in requisitioning you to help our kingdom. He has always been adept at following my requests.

I'm afraid I don't have time to elaborate much, so allow me to be blunt... and please, try to keep this from becoming common knowledge.
The Missing Diplomat

Recently a diplomat was sent to Theramore to meet with Jaina Proudmoore. That diplomat never arrived.

I believe the Defias are involved in this plot, but I'm not sure how. The diplomat's disappearance still eludes public attention, but it can't remain that way for long.

Agents of the king are already scouring the city for clues, but I have my own contacts I would like involved.

In the Valley of Heroes is an old friend of mine named Jorgen. Find him, give him this note, and follow his instructions.
Find Jorgen in Stormwind City.
Hmph, you better have good reason to interrupt a man and his fishin'. I don't take kindly to peddlers, let alone beggars.

Hmm... <Jorgen looks up at you through squinted eyes.>

All right. I'll help ya, but not because I want to, but because I'm obligated.

And let's get one thing straight: you're knowin' far more than you should to begin with. Let's keep this our little secret, and don't go blabbin' at any taverns about anything you find out. Understand?
The Missing Diplomat

Take this here note to Elling Trias. Don't say nothin' else to him. Just be polite and wait for him to respond. And don't worry, he will.

I'm gonna only impress this on ya once more, <name>: treat this matter seriously, and keep your yapper shut.

Ya can find Trias at his cheese shop, Trias' Cheese, in the Trade District. Good luck.
Delivery Jorgen's Sealed Note to Elling Trias in Stormwind City.
Hello, <name>. Is there something I can do for you? Perhaps you'd like to try some of our special Trias cheddar? Or a block of Darnassian bleu?
